senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חמם) [to be hot,] to desire, covet; to be carnally excited.
units: Nidd. 20ᵇ חֲמַדְתִּיו (or חִמַּ׳ Pi.) I had a desire for his embrace.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 19:15">Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 11</cite> <he>מי חְמָדָן</he> which (of the two) holds them desirable; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 676:1">Yalk. ib. 676</cite> [read]: <he>מי החוֹמְדִין</he>. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 8 <he>שאתה חומד וכ׳</he> that you may desire his daughter for your son; <he>ח׳ בדבור</he> expressing a desire by words (without thinking of means to obtain the object of his desire). [Ib. ed. Weiss, <he>אם התאוה סופו לַחֲמוֹד</he> if one desires (what belongs to his neighbor), he will finally covet it (think of means to obtain it). Ib. <he>אם ח׳ סופו וכ׳</he> if he covets, he will finally use force and rob.
B. Mets. 5ᵇ לאו דלא תַחְמוֹד, v. לַאו; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָמוּד, f. חֲמוּדָה desirable, precious.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 36:1">Pesik. R. s. 36</cite> <he>ח׳ ונאה</he> precious and fine (of conduct).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">Snh. VII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a">52ᵃ</cite>) Ar. (ref. to <cite ref="Daniel 10:3">Dan. X, 3</cite>; Var. <he>חמר</he>).

senses.gloss: to be desired, desirable. Tanḥ. Vayera 5 שאתה נֶחְמָד לפני וכ׳ that thou art held desirable before the Lord; a. e.—[

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:3">Ḥull. III, 3</cite> Ar., Var. <cite ref="H01220"><he>נחמר</he></cite>, v. supra.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:15">Macc. III, 15</cite> <he>שנפשו … מתאוה להן ומְחַמַּדְתָּן</he> which man longs for and covets.

senses.gloss: (with ל) to be anxious for; to be pleased with. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 17">Mishp. 17</cite> <he>ארץ שנִתְחַמְּדוּ לה וכ׳</he> a land which all the great men were anxious to possess (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 271:1">Yalk. Jer. 271</cite> <he>שהָמְדוּ</he>).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7:1">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite> <he>בוראך מִתְחַמֵּד לך</he> thy Creator is pleased with thee; <he>תורתו מִתְחַמֶּדֶת לך</he> His law is &c.
